Type: implementation task
Work key: CX02.2
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: The Candidate panel shows six hashes (candidate, base, manifest, interpretation, assessment, retry key) before the Accept button.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Candidate panel order: admissibility seal, finding summary, reason, Accept/Back, findings; identifiers move into a collapsed "Technical details".
2. Hash chips keep copy behaviour inside the disclosure; probes that read identifiers are updated, not removed.
3. Same treatment on the receipt (CX02.3).

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console.sh` (new guarded probes, current source 0 failures) and, where noted, `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js (previewCard aside, receiptCard)
